TIAI  READY

TI-84 AI firmware flasher

Writes the TI-84 AI firmware to a Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 at address 0x0. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer.

Firmware

Checking…

Flash

  1. Plug the XIAO into this computer with a USB-C data cable.
  2. Click the button. The first time, Chrome lists your board: select it and click Connect. After that it is found automatically.
  3. If it can't connect: hold BOOT, tap RESET, let go of BOOT, then try again.

After it finishes, the board restarts. On first start it opens its WiFi setup page so you can enter your WiFi and OpenAI key.
